description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Prismatic Ability +30% Boost 3] to all allies if the combined number of FF2 allies and non-FF2 allies with any Attach Dark is 4+, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Leon)] and [Darkness Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Prismatic Ability +30% Boost 3
description.text: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Holy, Dark and Poison abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Leon)
description.text: Darkness abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Darkness abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Darkness abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Darkness abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode II (Leon)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Darkness Mode I (Leon)] from the user
